summary:
HR & People Leader with 10+ years of experience across NwN India, Times OOH, and TCS, driving business-aligned HR strategy,
workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness.
Proven expertise in end-to-end employee lifecycle management including talent acquisition, onboarding, learning &
development, performance management, compensation reviews, and exits.
Strong background in PAN-India recruitment and workforce scaling, including campus hiring from Tier 1 & Tier 2 institutions
and delivery of 100+ consultant hires within a year.
Hands-on experience in HR transformation and change management, leading successful implementation of HRMS (Keka) and
expense management systems (Zaggle) to improve process efficiency and cost control.
Led annual and mid-year performance appraisal cycles and compensation review processes, ensuring pay equity, internal parity,
and market competitiveness across business units.
Trusted advisor on employee relations, grievance management, workplace conduct, rewards & recognition, and HR policy
governance across multi-location teams.
Demonstrated capability in employee engagement, retention, and culture initiatives, supported by data-driven insights and
leadership reporting.
Experienced people manager with a track record of leading and scaling recruitment teams (12+ members) and delivering high-
impact HR projects including sales incentive design, diversity and attrition analysis, and employee connect surveys.
